## Privacy-boundary assessment

LocalGate never edits user files, never indexes without a whitelist, and
never sends data off the machine. How does your proposal interact with these
boundaries?

- [ ] Reads user files only inside the whitelist (or not at all)
- [ ] Does not write or rename user files
- [ ] Adds no network calls other than loopback
- [ ] Adds no telemetry, remote fonts, CDNs or cloud error reporting
